responsibility: Declares the public folding and builder interfaces for GIMPLE simplification. It exposes entry points for folding statements and calls, following SSA edges to constants, rewriting overflow-sensitive expressions, simplifying constructors and indirect references, and constructing folded GIMPLE expressions and internal-function calls directly into statement sequences, as well as the public gimple_simplify hooks implemented by the generated matcher machinery.
same_name_distinction: Acts as the public API header for GIMPLE folding and folded-expression builders, with declarations and inline template wrappers for gimple_build/gimple_convert helpers, while the .cc file implements the actual statement-folding and simplification behavior.
